---
title: "Recipe 5 — Tune the CRS exclusion set without dropping the reference posture"
---

| Tool | Section | Level | Time | Layer | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`test/crs-differential`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/tree/main/test/crs-differential), any host with Go | CRS | medium | 15 min | crs · differential | crs, exclusions, parity |

### Problem

You want to silence one noisy CRS rule for one target. You want the community
baseline intact after the edit. You want a gate that catches drift.

### Solution

1. Read the committed exclusion set. The private ids `990001` to `990004` carry it
(`990001` = the response-body plumbing; the other three = the removals):

```text
SecRule REQUEST_FILENAME "!@rx ^/$" "id:990002,phase:1,pass,nolog,ctl:ruleRemoveTargetById=941010;REQUEST_FILENAME"
SecRule TX:DETECTION_PARANOIA_LEVEL "@ge 1" "id:990003,phase:1,pass,nolog,ctl:ruleRemoveById=921170"
```

2. Run the parity gate. The baseline against the committed set:

```bash
go test ./test/crs-differential/ -run TestCorpusParity -count=1
```

```text
parity 19/19 ran (1 skipped; target >= 90%) — zero unexplained deltas = gate
```

3. Probe the gate. Disable one exclusion (comment out id `990002` in
`test/crs-differential/testdata/seclang/engine.conf`) and run the gate again.
The gate fails and names the deltas:

```text
--- FAIL: TestCorpusParity/01-clean-post (0.00s)
    runner_test.go:61: parity delta: 941010 demotion evidence: want false, reference true
parity 13/19 ran (1 skipped; target >= 90%) — zero unexplained deltas = gate
```

4. Restore the edit. The gate reads green again.

### Discussion

The exclusion set lives as SecLang control rules with private ids. The ids sit
outside the CRS ranges: CRS parity semantics pin by includes and removes, never
by renumbering CRS. The corpus pins the observed rule-id sets per request. The
gate fails on any drift the edit introduces. Exclusion `990002` removes rule `941010` from the `REQUEST_FILENAME` target. Disabling it lets `941010` demote case evidence. The gate names the delta per case.

Tune by ids. Run the gate after every edit. The reference posture = the corpus
reading green at the pinned target.

on main, 2026-10-25.

Smoke run, 2026-10-25, on the host clone:

- Baseline gate: parity 19/19 ran (1 skipped), zero unexplained deltas, ok.
- Probe with id `990002` disabled: parity 13/19, FAIL, three named `941010 demotion evidence` deltas.
- Restore: parity green again. The tree reads clean after restore.
